name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on 4pc Gilded Dreams first and Scarlet Proof second for Stellar-Swirl, EM on the Sands and Goblet, Skill first, and Sunny Morning Sleep-In first, with Reliquary of Truth, A Thousand Floating Dreams and The Widsith next. Circlet: Game8 says EM; KQM says CRIT > EM (EM on every piece outside Stellar-Swirl, because plain Swirl cannot CRIT), so EM and CRIT Rate are both kept. KQM adds 4pc Viridescent Venerer for non-Stellar-Swirl teams. Talent order: KQM Skill > character level >> Burst, Game8 Skill > Burst > Normal Attack. The scaling stat is EM, not settled by the kit: its five 'check' lines (Skill DMG 57.7% and Continuous Attack 44.9% at level 1; Burst Skill DMG 94.1% and Munen Shockwave 70.6%) do not name a stat, but neither source builds ATK on her, and KQM calls her extra damage after a Swirl 'EM-scaling'; the lines are on the elemental curve (1.80 at level 10). Her healing is EM-based too, which is why she keeps allies alive. Neither source gives numeric stat goals. ER is KQM's range for a Burst every other rotation (100-130 in other teams, 100-120 with Sucrose or Faruzan; 120 used), and KQM says not to build ER actively.
